reserveReview.rationale: The October 26, 2026 Chronicle source payload (CID QmehrWWxwuvK2rV5BxqVH4upbk3ubGb4P7zBKwpDi9dNuh, followed from the configured Chronicle STAC proof page) directly identifies STAC fund NAV of $283,345,495.60 and 51 named CLO positions with aggregate portfolio market value $281,029,830.41, plus cash of $1,631,463.30 and other net assets/liabilities of $684,201.90. Against the September 29 payload (CID Qmedv33sWmMtXbho9dbZaXuFgsw7nL2c82UU6Rpt2aDY1J, 49 positions, $277,571,572.67, retained as a prior reference) all 49 original ISINs remain with unchanged units and maturity dates; two positions were added (AGL CORE CLO 5.31444% 07/20/2039, US001200AQ71, $2,502,524.50; ARINI US CLO V 5.27249% 04/15/2039, US04040CAA53, $1,000,496.50). The observed maximum position maturity is unchanged at 2041-07-17; it is an observation, not a legal maximum or WAM/WAL claim. The static reserve row remains the single 100% fund-NAV identity emitted by the live chronicle-nav adapter; its high-risk public-credit classification describes the identified fund claim, not a claim that every underlying asset is a CLO tranche. No PGIM AAA CLO ETF appears in this dated portfolio. Chronicle technically verifies third-party source data and expressly disclaims underlying-data attestation or audit. The older July position census and its maturity maximum are not carried forward.
